record.hypothesis: Across all four categories, scale visible input item vectors by 1+0.08*log1p(n)/log(129), where n is the visible real-item count; leave padding and mask unchanged. Weight masked-position cross-entropy by 3 at the final sequence position and 1 elsewhere, normalized by total weight. Set dropout=0.15 and LR=5e-4. The length cue distinguishes sparse context, final-position weighting aligns training with appended-mask inference, and gentler optimization stabilizes their interaction. Preserve embedding parameterization and backbone; use one checkpoint/category with matching predictor features, seed 42, 200 batches/epoch and at most 200 epochs.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, jointly set dropout to 0.15 and learning rate to 5e-4. Lower dropout preserves sparse context while smaller updates stabilize the length feature and final-position loss weighting.
Weight masked-target cross-entropy threefold at the final sequence position, normalized by total weight, to emphasize the position used by appended-mask inference.

Scale visible real-item input vectors by 1+0.08*log1p(n)/log(129), using only the visible real-item count. Padding and mask vectors remain unchanged. The generated predictor imports this model class, so the feature is shared automatically without checkpoint shape changes.
